entries.title: Block people
entries.description: Block someone from the … menu on their profile. You won't see each other's posts, comments, or profile, and they can't message you or send you a friend request. They aren't told.

entries.title: Mute people
entries.description: Mute someone from the … menu on their profile. Their posts, comments, and library updates are left out of your feeds and collapsed elsewhere, and they aren't told.

entries.title: Keyword filters
entries.description: Add a word or phrase in your Privacy settings, forever or for a day, week, or month. Posts, comments, and forum posts that mention it are collapsed, with a button to show them anyway.

entries.title: Mute conversations
entries.description: Mute a chat to keep it quiet. New messages won't pop it open or add to your unread count, and you can unmute it whenever you like.

entries.title: Hashtag pages respect 18+ and hidden content
entries.description: 18+ posts no longer show up on hashtag pages unless you've chosen to see them, and neither do posts from forum threads hidden from you.

entries.title: Editing text around a hashtag
entries.description: If typing next to a hashtag stretched its link, the post now keeps your text correctly when you edit it again. Tags too long to open no longer turn into broken links.
